scope: BI-339C441F root-cause fix. apps/web/lib/inference/semantic-memory.ts matches the [ai-context] persistent-surface rule, but nothing about the stored surface changes: this branch adds generateEmbeddingDetailed() in apps/web/lib/inference/embedding.ts so a LocalProviderCapacityDeferredError is reported as status "deferred" instead of being collapsed to null, and switches searchPlatformKnowledge to read that status so it can name the accurate reason. The embedding request itself, QDRANT_COLLECTIONS.PLATFORM_KNOWLEDGE, the filter, the similarity threshold, the payload projection and every stored vector are untouched. No asset, field, policy, or lifecycle change to any persistent surface occurred.
approver: platform-architecture (autonomous; operator-directed delivery of the filed BI-339C441F remediation)
rationale: A DataImpactManifest would have to fabricate change kinds for a stored surface whose shape did not move. The only new values in the system are an in-memory status discriminator on a function result and a human-readable reason string drawn from a closed three-value enum in local-provider-capacity.ts. A prior exception on the same surface was filed for the reporting half of this BI (changes/search-knowledge-availability-status.data-impact-exception.json, merged in PR #4434); this covers the root-cause half.
compensatingControl: apps/web/lib/inference/embedding.test.ts pins that a capacity deferral reports "deferred" carrying the lease reason, that a genuine backend error reports "failed", and that generateEmbedding still resolves null so its ~25 existing callers are unchanged. apps/web/lib/inference/semantic-memory-availability.test.ts pins that a deferral names local CI and says retryable without blaming the model, and that a deferral and a failure produce different reasons. The full lib/inference suite (47 files, 499 tests) passes, and tsc proves every caller compiles against the unchanged generateEmbedding contract.
